The '''Needan system''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Needan]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Geelan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At one point, a passing [[Unidentified comet|comet]] impacted the planet, causing its climate to become [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] to the point of extinction of the majority of its species. After the Geelans subsequently sent [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signals]] into outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]], an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Medic/Legends|medical]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] arrived at Needan and established first contact with the natives, leading to a dispersal of the Geelan into the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Description==
The Needan system<ref name="TEA" /> was a dying [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Zirtran">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref> situated in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained a single [[Star/Legends|star]] that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the life-rich terrestrial<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal13">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> [[Needan]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Geelan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At one point, the system also contained a passing [[Unidentified comet|comet]].<ref name="AlienEncounters" />

==History==
[[File:Geelan-SWAJ13.png|thumb|right|200px|The Geelan species was native to the Needan system's planet of the same name.]]
At one point, a passing [[Comet/Legends|comet]] impacted Needan. The collision sent the planet into a wider orbit<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|329|Geelan}}</ref> on a trajectory rapidly carrying it away from its sun. The consequent, rapid onset of permanently [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] and [[Winter/Legends|winter]]-like climate on Needan led to the extinction of the majority of the planet's species.<ref name="AlienEncounters" />

Geelan [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] eventually began sending out [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signals]] into outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Zirtran" /> the signals were intercepted by a [[Medic/Legends|medical]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crewed by members of the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] species, who tracked and followed the communication, leading them to Needan. As a result of the following offworlder visit, the Geelan learned of and adapted [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] technology. The fact that their homeworld was dying led many Geelan to emigrate and explore the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="AlienEncounters" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Needan system was first indirectly mentioned in "[[Zirtran's Anchor (article)|Zirtran's Anchor]]," a [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] article written by [[Tony Russo|Anthony P. Russo]] and published in the [[February]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Zirtran" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] named the system and placed it in grid square I-20.<ref name="TEA" />
